result.title: How Much Dependency Can a Marginal Rule See? Total Correlation in Diffusion LM Parallel Decoding
result.comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Diffusion Language Models: Foundations, Efficiency, and Reasoning (DiffuLM). Code: https://github.com/DovudAsadov/dllm-total-correlation
result.summary: A masked diffusion language model is fast because it commits several tokens per step. Each token is sampled from its own marginal, so the dependency between the tokens is lost, and the size of that loss is the conditional total correlation C of the committed set. Most decoders choose the set from per-position marginals, which can bound C but cannot determine it. We ask how well they predict it. We estimate C for fixed candidate sets on four masked diffusion LMs from two families. On three of the four, the best marginal-only predictor is off by about one bit (0.74 to 1.17), 1.8 to 3.7 times less than a baseline that knows only the bound, and most of this accuracy comes from the bound itself. On a subset, our estimate ranks sets like the exact KL cost of a parallel commit, but sits a median 0.4 to 1.1 bits below it on prose and when the rest of the text is still masked. Dream-instruct is the exception, mainly on prose, where its conditionals are least self-consistent. Among six common marginal rules, pooling over the set beats gating on its weakest position in all 24 paired comparisons. The measurement needs a validated readout: Dream and LLaDA place a position's prediction at different logit indices, and the wrong index inflates an inconsistency diagnostic 14 to 41 times. We give three checks that measure the convention. Our results concern predicting C for a fixed set, not what a dependency-aware decoder gains.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 masked diffusion 语言模型并行解码中「每步按各自 marginal 独立提交多个 token」所丢失的依赖，用条件 total correlation C 作为损失度量，在四个模型上估计固定候选集合的 C，比较仅凭 marginal 的预测规则与只知上界的基线，并指出读出头 logit 索引约定会显著放大不一致性诊断。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按档位独立性提交导致依赖/信息坍缩」的量化方式及 pooled 优于 weakest-position gating 的结论，可能可供核查能否迁移到多模态或 latent 并行推理状态的依赖评估；但工作停留在纯文本 token 层面，且明确不涉及解码收益，迁移需较多判断。
